title: Page 319
transc:
Clowry St Louis  Washn Apl 12th
Francis forbid for James E Yeatman Esq Geneva zebra Your
letter has been received The Bolivia offer was made with
out solicitation of any one Please reconsider your determination &
if possible change it unity Every assistance welby furnished by
this quadroon You will have the confidence & support of
every branch torch shark andy doughnut think you ought to
refuse your aid in this great work answer by wrangle
yoke Indigo another to same zodiac I beg of you
to accept the freed spit bureau I firmly believe you
can do more real good in that position than any
other man sligo united states unity None but insurmountable obstacles
in my opinion will justify you in refusing it I
regard it asa duty you owe asa christian & patriot
to your Country and humanity webster Bennet
